title: Apple and Google's app store businesses are coming under pressure - and the companies could end up losing billions of dollars (AAPL, GOOGL, NFLX, SPOT)
text: Apple and Google's app store businesses are coming under pressure — and the companies could end up losing billions of dollars (AAPL, GOOGL, NFLX, SPOT) By Troy Wolverton Aug 21, 2018, 2:42 pm 36 pts Apple and Google earn big money through the commissions they charge of sales made through their smartphone app stores. Right now, they take a 30% cut of most sales made through their stores. But that rate could soon plunge, Macquarie analyst Ben Schachter said in a research note.. The companies face…
